rationale.edition: Every changed path lives in OSS-owned locations — src/config/src/metrics.rs, src/core/src/logs/ingest.rs, web/src/components/ingestion/logs/SplunkHec.vue, web/src/locales/languages/*.json, and scripts/translations/. None are under o2_enterprise/ or any enterprise-gated module, and no enterprise keyword (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) appears in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping: there is no tests-added label or skip comment, and the change is user-facing — SplunkHec.vue adds a new warning banner and changes the example payload's time field, so it is not docs-only/CI-only/comment-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the Splunk HEC ingestion config view gains a new user-visible warning banner about the ingestion window and the copyable example payload now derives its time field from a live clock, both of which are UI behaviors a user can see and copy from.
rationale.area: The UI change lives in web/src/components/ingestion/logs/SplunkHec.vue, part of the ingestion configuration flow; the closest existing Playwright sibling is ingestion-config.spec.js, which the ci-matrix places in the GeneralTests group/area.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the existing testfolder shard that already carries ingestion-config.spec.js, the spec closest to this Splunk HEC ingestion UI; the new spec should join that shard. Note: there is no ci_matrix.json in the repo — the OSS base matrix is tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_env.json, and GeneralTests is its ingestion-config shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — the only changed test file is web/src/components/ingestion/logs/SplunkHec.spec.ts, a Vitest unit test, which does not count as Playwright E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/.
